patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Gong and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans sales-engagement; Ocean.io leans prospecting, data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs Ocean.io (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning sales-engagement vs Ocean.io-leaning prospecting, data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools.

Poor-fit cases: Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Avoid Gong if you actually need Ocean.io's motion (Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
